intro: One glass of sirap bandung has about 180 kcal (estimate). Calories come from the sweet rose syrup and condensed milk.
diet: Yes, especially for buka puasa or a kenduri. But it's one of the sweetest drinks at the kedai, so make it a treat, not a daily habit. One glass is okay if your main meal is controlled. Avoid going for a second glass or the soda and cincau versions too often.
tips: Ask for 'bandung kurang manis' or half the syrup.
Ask for more ice so the glass is full but with less syrup.
If making at home, use low-fat fresh milk and less syrup.

swap.name: Bandung kurang manis
swap.why: Same pink colour and rose flavour, just less sugar.

faq.a: 'Bandung' refers to mixing two things together, which is syrup and milk. It's not from the city of Bandung.

faq.q: Is bandung soda nice, and how do I make it?
faq.a: Mix syrup, condensed milk and soda water. It's more refreshing and fizzy, but slightly higher in calories.

faq.q: Can I make bandung with fresh milk?
faq.a: Yes. It's less rich and sweet, but lighter and lower in calories.
